claims.claim: The bundle studies how an organization preserves useful state across changing models and constrained resources.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: This is an interpretive synthesis of S11’s atlas, S24’s deferred-history analogy, S15’s file-driven work and S19’s active-belief design. Its unit of continuity is the governed organization, not necessarily an individual model or one conversation. The coherent thesis is conditional: preserve validated structure, recover detail when needed, and bind action to an independently checked contract.
claims.change_mind: A competing reading explains the same source passages better, or the operator revises the aim.

claims.claim: The map covers all 37 supplied artifacts, but is not an exhaustive close reading of every word.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: Inventory: 35 text/JSON/Markdown files, one PDF and one image; 7,953,449 bytes. Text extraction yields69,438 lines and 732,428 whitespace-delimited words, with overlap and quoted exports. All text was indexed; named passages received close reading. The source map, excerpt records and candidate-reference index expose that coverage.
claims.change_mind: Hash/count reproduction fails or a required source was omitted.

claims.claim: Repeated documents and model summaries are not independent witnesses.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S30 is byte-identical to the earlier audit PDF. S01 contains prior review/protocol text. S23 explicitly warns that parts of its bibliography came from model memory. Transcripts can contain an assertion, its paraphrase and a later citation to the paraphrase. Those form one evidence lineage until a new observation is established.
claims.change_mind: Distinct source custody and independently obtained observations establish additional witnesses.

claims.claim: The operator’s design values include retained control, exit and inspectable decisions.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S15 places job contracts and verification in files and retains human approval for spends. S28 proposes origination, discrimination, reality contact, exit, control retention and transparency as sovereignty dimensions. These are documented design preferences; the proposed proxy scores are not validated measurements of human agency.
claims.change_mind: Contrary controlling specifications or user clarification change the values; validated instruments would change the measurement status.

claims.claim: A locally controlled core is not evidence that every demonstrated workflow is cloud-independent.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: The model atlas explicitly allows remote weight materialization and provider jobs. S15 routes subscription seats; S10 describes a Discord-facing workflow. Specify an offline service floor, optional remote enhancements, local data authority and recovery portability separately. Removing all network access is a test, not a definition fulfilled by local files.
claims.change_mind: An offline run completes the named core tasks with declared quality, resources and recovery.

claims.claim: The model RIB is an atlas and experiment contract, not compressed model weights.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S11:5–7,26–39,57–65 says this explicitly. Identity, lineage, runtime requirements, behavior distributions and routing receipts can be represented compactly without reproducing a model’s latent knowledge. RenderMan supplies an interface/scene-description analogy; it does not imply that an arbitrary neural model has a small lossless behavioral genome.
claims.change_mind: A different adopted RIB contract explicitly makes and demonstrates the stronger representation claim.

claims.claim: A small driver with recoverable archives could improve context management.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S24:67–127 identifies the useful mechanism and disanalogy: deferred scene assets versus uncertain future information needs. Preserve immutable source spans and tool-result identities beside summaries, track unresolved obligations, and retrieve bounded detail. That makes recovery possible; it does not guarantee that a model will retrieve the right source at the right time.
claims.change_mind: Held-out long tasks show improved constraint retention and task completion after charging retrieval, compaction and cache costs.

claims.claim: Deterministic metadata is not inherently infallible.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S24:114 says metadata cannot be wrong. Deterministic extraction can hash the wrong bytes, omit a span, preserve an obsolete path or use a flawed parser. Hashes prove identity relative to an input, not completeness or semantic fidelity. The row 122 audit is a concrete reminder that different hash definitions can be confused.
claims.change_mind: An appropriately narrowed claim states and verifies the extractor’s invariants and source binding; planted omissions are detected.

claims.claim: The Render Decision Engine is a useful testable policy proposal, not a validated cognitive law.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S28:20–60 selects rendering fidelity using cost, risk and user-control preferences; S27 diagrams cache/small-model/frontier choices. Separate answer-cache reuse, evidence retrieval, model selection and procedural presentation. The documents’ LOD numbering varies; this brief names the operation instead of assuming a universal numeric order. A small model may be more suitable on one task, not uniformly less faithful.
claims.change_mind: A fixed workload and calibrated risk metric show better cost-quality-control tradeoffs than static routing and simple threshold baselines.

claims.claim: Stable exact prefixes can reduce repeated prefill in supporting runtimes.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: Official caching documentation supports the mechanism. Keep stable instructions before changing task material where the chosen runtime permits it. This is conditional on cache identity, model/runtime compatibility, retention and workload. It does not make output generation, tools, transfers or verification free; old price ratios are not portable constants.
claims.change_mind: A pinned runtime and trace violate the documented cache behavior after cache eligibility and eviction are accounted for.

claims.claim: A cache-hit rate is not a coordination or truth score.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S19:1–11 already attacks this inference. A fixed prefix can be reused while workers disagree about new facts or repeat a false premise. Meter cached tokens with a declared denominator, then separately measure task correctness, acknowledged updates and authorized effects. A rate without a time window and token class is not comparable.
claims.change_mind: A separate causal experiment demonstrates coordination gain; the cache rate would still remain a different variable.

claims.claim: Cross-model cache transfer and behavioral continuity remain separate unproven fleet properties.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S17:32–52 distinguishes token, KV and behavioral identity. A migration tuple should bind model revision, tokenizer, template, runtime, policy version and any mapper. Test native prefill and mapped state against the same behavioral contract; cheap transfer cannot substitute for authority and task-quality checks.
claims.change_mind: Reproduced local migration results establish both state compatibility and no unacceptable behavioral regression within the declared task envelope.

claims.claim: Plan-informed memory/cache scheduling has close prior art.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: A broad no-prior claim is defeated by RAGCache, TeleRAG, PerCache and now PBKV’s explicit workflow prediction, conservative prefetch and eviction. Distinguish cached objects: document embeddings, retrieved text, prefix KV and answers. PBKV’s workload-specific training and eight-A6000 testbed prevent direct transfer of its performance to this PC. The candidate contribution is a tested integration with authorization and provenance.
claims.change_mind: A narrower literature-bounded novelty claim identifies a mechanism or guarantee absent from the closest systems and validates it.

claims.claim: Content-hash lookup does not make natural-language retrieval O(1).
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: Expected constant-time table access presumes the key is already known. Query interpretation, chunk selection, similarity search, transfer, freshness and authorization still have costs. Chain-leaf identity also needs an explicit mapping to content/chunk identity.
claims.change_mind: The claim is narrowed to known-key retrieval and benchmarked separately from end-to-end semantic search.

claims.claim: Whole-corpus residency and memory benefit remain unproven deployment claims.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: The prior brief’s bounded cache path found 328 snippets and no embedding allocation there; it did not establish whole-estate coverage. A proposed 19million256-dimensional fp16 table needs 9.728 GB for vectors alone; keys and uint64IDs raise the arithmetic to 10.488 GB before index/runtime overhead. That proposal is distinct from verified allocation or historical1.3 M-file scope.
claims.change_mind: A sealed eligible-file/chunk/slot manifest reconciles, actual peak memory fits the resource envelope, and matched tests show a net benefit.

claims.claim: Trace placement introduces a quality-versus-cache tradeoff worth testing.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: Trace as State supports a placement effect on its long-context tasks, while explicitly noting extra passes and potential loss of KV reuse. It did not evaluate multi-round agent tasks. For this fleet, compare source-backed state before context, after context and bounded retrieval; do not assume summary text is a faithful record of internal computation. Use only state interfaces actually exposed by the system.
claims.change_mind: Equal-total-budget held-out tasks show a reproducible quality/latency benefit, including compaction and prefill charges.

claims.claim: Replacing continue with an inbox row is an autonomy hypothesis, not an executed guarantee.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: The operator runbook documents manual dispatch and verification. The proposed driver adds admission, watchdogs, stop rules and folding. A complete bounded loop needs persistent intent IDs, retry budgets that survive replacement, atomic concurrency limits, meaningful postconditions and an external stop path. Repeated activity alone does not establish progress.
claims.change_mind: An unattended frozen workload survives registered crashes/quota loss and satisfies correctness, resource and stop conditions.

claims.claim: A hash-chained history alone does not supply safe durable execution.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: Temporal-style replay and RIFL-style destination duplicate suppression require contracts beyond append-and-audit. Stable operation identity, transactional effect/deduplication boundaries, receiver fencing and explicit UNKNOWN outcomes are essential. Retrying a noncooperating destination after an ambiguous timeout can duplicate an effect. The retained broker contract is a draft reference, not evidence of runtime enforcement.
claims.change_mind: Crash-window tests at each effect boundary establish no unauthorized or duplicate commitment and resolve or retain uncertainty honestly.

claims.claim: Reported success must be checked against semantic postconditions.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: The prior audit found a swallowed-failure pattern and distinguished log-row counts from unique operations. A healthy process or HTTP 200 can coexist with wrong or absent work. Use intent/attempt/result identities, typed dispositions, an independent observer and a postcondition appropriate to each effect. This supports the measurement requirement; current fleet-wide coverage remains unmeasured.
claims.change_mind: An independently calibrated inventory proves equivalent coverage through another mechanism, or a proposed meter is shown to miss injected failures.

claims.claim: Routing should use measured task-relative passports and observed availability.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S11 specifies distributions, coverage and cost; S15 documents quota-sensitive seat selection. Test such a router against static cheap, strong and simple-threshold baselines. Idle does not logically mean unhealthy: rare emergency, accessibility or specialist organs can be valuable. Separate disabled, unavailable, quota-blocked, unprobed and healthy-idle states.
claims.change_mind: A local benchmark shows net cost savings at preregistered quality and authority margins, with acceptable fallback delay.

claims.claim: External gates can be model-independent without making the whole fleet ablation-proof.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S35’s board/switchboard/broker separation is the correct architectural question. Every protected effect must be mediated; ambient credentials and writable policy files can bypass a nominal gate. Refusal studies concern selected behavior, not all alignment. S3’s model-generated refusal cannot demonstrate a receiver blocking a noncompliant worker.
claims.change_mind: Bounded adversarial tests show complete mediation and no unauthorized effect across direct calls, replays, stale grants and changed workers.

claims.claim: Independent proposals and controlled information exchange are hypotheses about marginal information gain.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S29:330–377 rejects persona names as diversity and agreement as verification. Model families, tools, source corpora and graders can remain correlated. Compare one stronger/equal-budget model, independent aggregation and permitted interaction with the same total opportunity budget. Preserve minority-correct propositions and explicit unresolved collisions.
claims.change_mind: Held-out oracle-graded tasks show benefit beyond extra tokens, tool access and evaluator leakage.

claims.claim: New private observations require a communication path to affect another worker.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S17:1–28 identifies a boundary: a frozen shared prefix cannot itself contain events observed after its freeze. Files, typed deltas or a board can carry those updates; they are communication mechanisms. The required acknowledgment strength depends on the task. Do not claim all coordination needs mathematical common knowledge, or that identical text proves shared interpretation.
claims.change_mind: A counterexample demonstrates information transfer without any causal channel under the stated isolation assumptions; otherwise revise which acknowledgment level a task requires.

claims.claim: AUDIT, BELIEF and HEAD are distinct proposed state responsibilities already present in the corpus.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S19:76–122 preserves historical events while tombstoning or superseding their active influence and marking dependents stale. This is a design proposal with truth-maintenance antecedents, not proof it is deployed. Archive retention also needs an explicit privacy/deletion policy; append-only is not an unconditional command to retain every secret forever.
claims.change_mind: The source mapping is incorrect, or an adopted state contract supersedes it; implementation status changes only with replay and revocation tests.

claims.claim: The receipt compiler was already proposed before this addendum; it is not a newly discovered missing idea.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S22:155–166 specifies claim, status, expected/observed checks, context-address, tool hashes, model identity, cost and parent hashes plus outsider disputes. This corrects the framing of the September 16 recommendation: the missing evidence is execution/admission coverage and adoption, not absence of the design. File presence alone does not prove historical priority beyond the supplied record.
claims.change_mind: An earlier controlling specification or implementation changes the lineage or demonstrates that the admission boundary is already enforced.

claims.claim: Prompt genetics and ontology revision need an independent promotion gate.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S04 proposes self-modifying constraints; S03 records doctrine edits. More coherent wording can still encode an incorrect lesson or narrower dissent. Preserve a frozen parent, versioned candidate, source failures and deployment rollback. A weight-unchanged context effect is not the same experiment as training a student from a context-conditioned teacher.
claims.change_mind: A frozen parent/candidate/token-matched-irrelevant comparison improves held-out outcomes without expanding authority or hiding failed folds.

claims.claim: The current QA score spread does not validate competence-versus-compliance discrimination.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: The September 16 audit found altered twins and I3 grading that rewards unsupported missing-store assertions. These are specific construct and scoring defects. Twelve form names map partly to reused receipts. Keep calibration attempts, amendments and failed runs separate from a fresh confirmatory sample; do not turn more generated answers into independent task instances.
claims.change_mind: Correct twins, independent masked grading, ground-truth controls and executable inference establish the intended construct.

claims.claim: The September 16 wave122 failure is a dated counterexample to receipt closure.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: At 04:52:54 UTC the preserved audit snapshot had a wrong previous hash and no stored row hash. The existing verifier returned failure. This dossier carries forward that observation; it does not recheck current production state or assert the failure persists today. A repaired successor must retain the failed snapshot and explicit supersession.
claims.change_mind: A later versioned recovery receipt changes current status without erasing the historical failure.

claims.claim: Games offer a bounded proving ground for the organization’s authority and recovery contracts.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S07–S10 move from reusable rule families to testable engine bones. The research advantage is controllable initial states, legal actions, hidden information and a scoring oracle. A language-model game master is not automatically deterministic; define which transitions are code-enforced and which are judged. Cultural variants need provenance rather than a falsely universal ruleset.
claims.change_mind: A small game fixture reveals agent-state and authority failures and produces transferable tests for non-game tasks.

claims.claim: The 24 selected test passes support bounded component behavior, not an end-to-end public referee.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: The retained rerun covers 12 bones, 8 family and 4 manifest tests. The inspected Dispatch models a gate; complete session replay and a non-admin Discord turn remained unproven in that snapshot. The attached 325-message export documents development context, not a replacement for a receiver-side session receipt.
claims.change_mind: A same-byte rerun fails, or a new integrated receipt upgrades the deployed-referee claim.

claims.claim: Reproducing a canary is not sufficient to identify training ingestion.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: Retrieval, history, cache or another component can supply the same string. The prior four-route assay separates these exposures. Authenticated training membership and measured extraction sensitivity are different variables. Neither the hash registry nor the ten-duplicate heuristic supplies a universal causal proof.
claims.change_mind: Controlled custody and independently verified exposure routes support a narrowly specified inference, with false-positive and sensitivity estimates.

claims.claim: Bubbles, spores, Fourier bases and rank are analogies unless their mathematical objects are specified.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S02, S05, S26 and S03 use physical or algebraic language to reason about packaging, composition and capability gaps. The cited bubble paper addresses a physical shape problem. Nonlinear agent interactions need not be an orthogonal linear basis; a p-value does not by itself measure matrix singularity. Preserve the useful question each analogy generates, then specify variables, assumptions and a falsifier.
claims.change_mind: A formal mapping with stated domain and experimentally checked predictions replaces the loose equivalence.

claims.claim: Trainable physical computation is a real research branch with a distinct validation burden.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: Wright and colleagues demonstrate hybrid physical/digital training on controllable physical systems. This supports S31’s search/configure/measure/calibrate loop as an adjacent research direction. It does not validate10,000-fold whole-system savings, universal digital replacement or the fleet’s software architecture. Account for sensing, conversion, control, training, error correction and useful output.
claims.change_mind: End-to-end measurements refute or establish a particular substrate/task advantage under matched quality and lifecycle accounting.

claims.claim: The parables and flame image express design values, not measurements of model identity or experience.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S20 contrasts countable chairs with promised rooms; S21 questions the observer and proposes controls. S37 visually presents a person holding a smiling flame. Reading that as stewardship, fragility and continuity is an interpretation, not identification of the person or evidence of sentience. Cultural binaries in S25 and AI first-person narration require separate scrutiny.
claims.change_mind: The operator supplies another intended interpretation; empirical consciousness claims would require a separate justified framework.

claims.claim: Cost and scale claims require explicit units, scope and opportunity accounting.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: S36 has billing-like zero-price entries and S33 discusses quota corrections. Historical plan allowances, cached input, uncached input, output tokens, wall time, energy and operator labor are different dimensions. Summed input tokens across calls are not one context window. Stored file counts, eligible corpus entries, indexed chunks and models loaded in RAM are also different denominators.
claims.change_mind: Frozen usage and resource records reconcile with invoice/plan rules and per-task successful outcomes.

claims.claim: The defensible contribution is an evaluated integration and a reusable evidence interface.
claims.evidence_and_reasoning: The bundle already contains many mechanisms and their counterarguments. A publishable contribution would connect versioned representation, graded retrieval, explicit authority, durable effects and independently checkable correction under a constrained local envelope. Success is improved task outcomes and reproducible failures versus strong baselines, not a count of metaphors, tools, commits or agreeing models.
claims.change_mind: Independent users reproduce a bounded benefit or demonstrate that simpler systems match it at lower cost.
